title: Ofimeo school configuration (ofimeo.config.json)
description: Put this file next to index.html (or pass it to Ofimeo Relay with --school-config). Every property is optional; values that are not valid are ignored. See docs/deploy-school.md.

school.description: Shown next to the Ofimeo name on the home screen.

logo.description: Image next to index.html (e.g. school/logo.svg, cached for offline use) or an https:// address.

url.description: School website, linked from the name.

language.description: Interface language when the person has not chosen one (lock it with locked: ["language"]).

documentLanguage.description: Language of new text (spelling and grammar): a code or a regional variant.

relay.description: The school's Ofimeo Relay (docs/relay.md). Used unless the person set another one; always when locked includes "relay".

only.description: Use only the school relay for signaling (no public Nostr relays or STUN servers). Fixed when "relay" is locked.

relays.description: Extra Nostr relays, used together with the school relay (and the public ones, if allowed).

iceServers.description: Extra STUN/TURN servers (RTCIceServer). Credentials here are visible to everyone who can load the file; prefer Ofimeo Relay, which hands out short-lived ones.

store.description: Store-and-forward: where encrypted document changes may wait for people who are offline. Both are allowed by default.

servers.description: Offered in Connect to Nextcloud; the first one is filled in. With locked ["nextcloud"], only these can be used.

webmcp.description: false: AI assistants (WebMCP) cannot be turned on.

ai.description: false: no AI features at all (also turns WebMCP off).

publicRelays.description: false: only the school's servers (relay, nostr.relays, iceServers); give at least one of them.

templates.description: Templates of the home screen gallery: all, none or a list of template ids (src/templates/catalog.ts; the generator lists them).

hiddenApps.description: Apps not offered for new documents (documents of that kind still open).

legal.description: The school's privacy contacts, shown above the legal links (home screen and About). The built-in legal pages stay available.

locked.description: Settings people cannot change; the settings show "Set by your school". language: needs defaults.language. webmcp: AI assistants stay off. relay: needs relay.url. nextcloud: needs nextcloud.servers.
